title: Deductible and Betterment on Insurance Claim Repairs — Billing Desk Accounting Rules
content:
On an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order the customer's share of an insured repair is the deductible plus betterment.

## Deductible

**Coverage carrying a deductible.** For a claim paid under collision, comprehensive or uninsured motorist property damage coverage, a deductible charge posts on the authorization date for the lesser of the deductible the insurer stated and the original estimate. A third-party liability claim carries no deductible.

**Further deductible on a supplement.** When a later approved supplement raises the authorized total while the deductible assessed is still below the stated deductible, a further deductible charge posts with that supplement's number, for the lesser of the remaining deductible and the supplement's approved amount.

**Quantities used.**
- The *deductible assessed* is the total of the deductible charges on the repair order, less the credits made against them.
- The *authorized total* is the total of the insurer's approvals of the original estimate and of supplements, less any total-loss reversal and withdrawal reversal adjustments.
- Each deductible charge is the lesser of the stated deductible and the authorized total, less the deductible assessed before it, and never less than zero.

**Collection.** The deductible is owed by the class's deductible collection point — at delivery, before release — and is never waived, reduced, discounted, absorbed or rebated by the network, in cash or in kind; a request to do so is refused.

## Betterment

Betterment posts as its own charge, for the betterment the insurer applied within each approval.

## Insurer offset

Every deductible charge and every betterment charge is mirrored by an insurer offset of the same amount, taken off what the insurer owes.

## Worked example (hypothetical collision claim, stated deductible USD 500.00)

| Event | Authorized total after it | Deductible assessed before it | Deductible charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original estimate USD 350.00 authorized | USD 350.00 | USD 0.00 | lesser of 500.00 and 350.00, i.e. USD 350.00 |
| Supplement 1 approved for USD 400.00 | USD 750.00 | USD 350.00 | remaining deductible USD 150.00 is less than USD 400.00, so USD 150.00 |
| Supplement 2 approved for USD 200.00 | USD 950.00 | USD 500.00 | nothing remains, so no further deductible charge |

Each of the two deductible charges is mirrored by an insurer offset of USD 350.00 and USD 150.00 respectively. Had the claim been a third-party liability claim, no deductible charge would have posted at all.
